title: Reject a trip with a reason
summary: The controller rejects a request and says why, so the requester knows what to do.
processing: The request waits for the controller.
evaluation: The controller decides it cannot be done.
records: The reason is stored on the trip and in the history.
closure: The trip is Rejected and final.

exceptions.then: The screen asks for a reason and nothing changes.

steps.action: Click Request a trip, fill it in and click Send request
steps.label: Send request

steps.action: Open the trip, type a reason and click Reject trip
steps.label: Reject trip

steps.action: Open the trip to read the reason
steps.expect: The reason 'No vehicle is free' is shown
